description: Fetch a workflow run's metadata + status. Mirrors GET /api/v2/repos/.../actions/runs/:id. Also says how it relates to automatic retries: `retryOf` / `retryOfRunNumber` (the run this one retries after a deploy or a lost runner) and `retriedAs` ({id, runNumber} of the run that retried this one, or null).

run_id.description: The run's id, or a unique leading part of it (8+ hex characters)

name: gluecron_get_workflow_run
